'''Zhao Zhentang''' ({{zh|s=赵振堂}}; born May 1961) is a Chinese engineer and currently vice-president of the Shanghai Advanced Research Institute, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He is a member of the [[Chinese Nuclear Society]] (CNS) and the [[Chinese Physical Society]] (CPS).

==Biography==
Zhao was born in May 1961. After the resumption of [[National College Entrance Examination]], he enrolled at [[Tsinghua University]]. He carried out postdoctoral research at the [[Institute of High Energy Physics]] in 1990. For the next few years he continued his laboratory work at the institute, where he took part in the research of Beijing Electron Positron Collider (BEPC). He was a visiting scholar at the [[CERN|European Organization for Nuclear Research]] (CERN). In 1998 he moved to [[Shanghai]] to participate in the construction of Shanghai light source accelerator.<ref>{{cite news |author1=Liu Yu ({{lang|zh|刘禹}}) |url=http://www.sast.gov.cn/view/36/25583.html |script-title=zh:追“光”者——访中国工程院新院士赵振堂 |work=Shanghai Association of Science and Technology |date=5 December 2019 |access-date=3 February 2020 |language=zh |archive-date=3 February 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200203104404/http://www.sast.gov.cn/view/36/25583.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |author1=Shu Shu ({{lang|zh|舒抒}}) |url=http://sh.eastday.com/m/20180810/u1ai11709977.html |script-title=zh:“上海光源”开放试运行9年，有力支撑国家实验室建设 |work=eastday.com |date=10 August 2018 |access-date=3 February 2020 |language=zh |archive-date=3 February 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200203104402/http://sh.eastday.com/m/20180810/u1ai11709977.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> He served as deputy director of the Shanghai Institute of Applied Physics in June 2001, and nine years later promoted to the director position. In December 2018 he joined the Shanghai Advanced Research Institute and was appointed as vice-president. He has been director of the [[Shanghai Synchrotron Radiation Facility]] since 2019. He is a researcher at the Shanghai Key Laboratory of Cryogenic & Superconducting RF Technology.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://srf.sinap.cas.cn/ryjg/xsdtr/ |script-title=zh:上海市低温超导高频腔技术重点实验室学术带头人 |work=Shanghai Key Laboratory of Cryogenic & Superconducting RF Technology |date=2019 |access-date=3 February 2020 |language=zh |archive-date=6 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241106115340/http://srf.sinap.cas.cn/ryjg/xsdtr/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
